table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = 
		case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' 
		else case WHEN max(saledetail.Alternatecustomicode) is null OR saledetail.Alternatecustomicode = '' then item.name else (SELECT AI.Name FROM AlternateItemAlias AI WHERE AI.ICode=saledetail.icode AND saledetail.Alternatecustomicode = AI.CustomICode) end end, 
	altersaleinvcode=max(saleledger.altersaleinvcode),
	alternatecustomicode=isnull(max(saledetail.Alternatecustomicode),'  '),
	alternatepackingdesc=isnull((select packingdesc from AlternateItemAlias where AlternateItemAlias.customicode=max(saledetail.Alternatecustomicode)),''),
	alternateitemqty= isnull((select qty from AlternateItemAlias where AlternateItemAlias.customicode=max(saledetail.Alternatecustomicode)),1),
	users.username,  
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	custref=max(saleledger.custrefno),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	customeralias=(select accounts.aliasname from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	gcode=max(dbo.saledetail.gcode), 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	alternatepackunits=(case  When saledetail.Alternatecustomicode is null then max(saledetail.packunits) else (select qty from alternateitemalias where alternateitemalias.customicode=saledetail.Alternatecustomicode) end),
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	packqtyforsale = max(saledetail.packqtyforsale), 
	itemnetrate=(  max(saledetail.packsaleprice) -   max(saledetail.itemflatdisc * saledetail.looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail.discperc  * .01 )  )  ,
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	itemgstperc=MAX(saledetail.gstperc),
	SalesTaxSchedule_prec = (SELECT MAX(STS.taxperc) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	itemunitsalestax=saledetail.unitsalestax,
	discperc  = saledetail.discperc, 
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	totaltaxonInv=dbo.fn_gettaxonsaleinv(saleledger.saleinvcode),
	fiscalinvoiceno = saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
	invtotal = max(saleledger.invtotal),
	cashtendered=max(saleledger.cashtendered),
	cashcharged=max(saleledger.cashcharged),
	CardCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=:ra_InvCode),0),
	balance=ISNULL(max(saleledger.balance), 0), 
	amt=isnull(max(saleledger.amt),0) + isnull(saleledger.cashcharged,0) + ISNULL((select isnull(sum(amount),0) from cashierwindow where cashierwindow.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	PreviousLoyalty = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE 
			LC.AccCode = dbo.saleledger.custcode AND 
			ISNULL(LC.InvoiceType,'') + STR(ISNULL(LC.InvoiceCode,0)) <> 'SV' + STR(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode)), 0),
	PointsAdded = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE LC.AccCode = dbo.saleledger.custcode AND LC.InvoiceType = 'SV' AND LC.InvoiceCode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	TotalLoyalty = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE LC.AccCode = dbo.saleledger.custcode), 0),
	FBRPOSFee=saleledger.FBRPOSFee,
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter)
FROM dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.headerno,
			saleledger.salestax,
			saleledger.amt,
			saleledger.cashcharged, 
			saleledger.remarks, 
			saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
			saleledger.FBRPOSFee,
			saledetail.icode, 
			saledetail.saleprice,
			saledetail.itemflatdisc,
			saledetail.discperc,
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			item.customicode,
			saledetail.Alternatecustomicode,
			Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
			users.username
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.expression: sum((  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 )  )      for all)

objects.name: c_totaldiscval
objects.expression: Sum ( (  looseqty *  (saledetail_saleprice -  itemflatdisc) )  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 )  )  +round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)
